description: Paramak, published by fusion-energy, generates parameterized three-dimensional fusion-reactor CAD and neutronics geometry. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The package produces CadQuery geometry exportable to STEP, STL or BRep; conversion to DAGMC uses separate tooling. A generated geometry is not a validated neutronics model. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
